mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) over the past month signals an easing monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines by at least 0.10 percentage points over the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeds 6.5%, it signals a weakening labor market that prompts central bank intervention, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as investors anticipate policy support.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE > 6.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1) and monthly housing starts (HOUST) signals a broad-based economic slowdown, which triggers a flight to quality in equities and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as the market prices in a potential policy response.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when both GDPC1 and HOUST decline from their prior values.

mechanism_narrative: In a manufacturing contraction (INDPRO < 100), the S&P 500 tends to rise over the next 20 days as investors anticipate central bank stimulus to counteract the slowdown, but this effect is absent during expansionary supply conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO < 100.

mechanism_narrative: A strong retail sales figure (RSAFS) indicates robust consumer spending, which supports corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when RSAFS exceeds its 12-month moving average.

mechanism_narrative: When monthly nonfarm payrolls growth (PAYEMS) exceeds 200,000, it signals a strong labor market that may lead to inflationary pressures and subsequent monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS > 200.

mechanism_narrative: A rising CPI (CPIAUCSL) combined with a stable or rising federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals persistent inflation and the potential for aggressive monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL rises and FEDFUNDS is stable or rising.

mechanism_narrative: In a housing market downturn (HOUST < 1000), the S&P 500 tends to rise over the next 20 days as the market anticipates fiscal stimulus to support the economy, but this effect is muted during housing market expansions.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST < 1000.
